name: Data Browser Effluent Plant (Web)
implementation_notes: EffluentPlantRecordService/Controller/routes/factories are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Effluent Plant screens (095/105/115), mirroring ProcessWaterRecordService's precedent -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence

Effluent Plant follows the same hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row, 1..24 rows, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) pattern as Process Water -- create()/update()/listRecords()/export()/getDetail(), plus canonicalTimeSlots() helper returning 24 'HH:00' strings starting 07:00

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 19 non-time_slot columns (anaerobic_pond_1/2_ph/temp_c, cooling_pond_ph/temp_c, biogas_flare_status, biogas_flow_rate_m3h, raw_pome_feed_rate_m3h, effluent_discharge_flow_rate_m3h, final_discharge_ph/bod/cod/tss, dosing_pump_1_status, chemical_consumed_kgl, sludge_dewatering_status, remarks_maintenance_actions, findings) -- mirrors ProcessWaterRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern; UNLIKE Process Water, this station has NO identifying/context columns to exclude (no shift/inspector_id equivalent), so all 19 columns participate

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: 3 of the 19 detail columns (biogas_flare_status, dosing_pump_1_status, sludge_dewatering_status) are backed by a SQLite CHECK constraint (Laravel enum()) that rejects an empty string. EffluentPlantRecordService::normalizeDetails() coerces '' to null for these 3 columns specifically before validation/persistence -- the same mitigation Kernel Dispatch needed for its own enum column, and a case Process Water never hit since it has no enum detail columns at all. Caught and fixed proactively per this task's explicit instruction before any test failure occurred.

UNLIKE Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant: Effluent Plant has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder, no model, no Target Operasional section anywhere in this station's 6 screens, per this task's explicit scope

The Effluent Plant tile in production-process-activity.blade.php (screen-035) already existed as an active-styled tile pointing to javascript:void(0) (added by an earlier task alongside the DEFAULT_STATIONS/StationType groundwork) -- this implementation changes ONLY that one tile's href to route('data.effluent-plant'), leaving all other tiles unchanged

tests/Feature/ProductionProcessActivityTest.php (pre-existing, not owned by this screen) was updated additively: the Effluent Plant assertion moved from the '6 still-unrouted' test into the '9 active station tiles linking to their Data Browser routes' test, and both test names/counts were corrected from 6 to 5 remaining unrouted -- mirrors the exact precedent Process Water/CPO Dispatch set for this same shared test file when their own Data Browser screens were implemented
StationFactory::effluentPlant() state added additively (mirrors processWater()/kernelDispatch()/cpoDispatch() exactly) for this screen's and screen-115's test suites
Ran the full backend test suite (`php artisan test`) after all changes: 1704 passed (0 failed), confirming no regression to any pre-existing screen

deferred_items.description: The mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button (Station List, screen-006) does not push locally-entered Effluent Plant records to POST /api/effluent-plant-records -- unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Kernel Dispatch/CPO Dispatch, which each have a syncEffluentPlantRecords()-equivalent function wired into syncService.ts's syncAllRecords()
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Process Water) made the same deferral for the same reason. The route itself is already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role, see routes/api.php) so this is purely a mobile syncService.ts addition, not a backend change, when picked up later.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DataBrowserEffluentPlantTest.php) was authored following this codebase's established convention (a .php file containing Playwright TS syntax, excluded from phpunit.xml's testsuites, meant to be run separately via `playwright test` against a live dev server) but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review, consistent with every other Browser/* spec in this codebase.
